shadows.name: floating-action
shadows.purpose: Separate the central add action from the tab bar; do not use on content surfaces.

motion.name: state-feedback
motion.purpose: Pressed, focus, loading, and reveal feedback only; respect reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Warm, tactile primary action for the main decision in a local area.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: #506B35; color: #FFFDF8; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; font: 600 16px/22px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #455D2F; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #506B35; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: scale(0.985); }

components.name: Secondary Food Action
components.description: A distinct secondary route for recording food already consumed.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { background: #F4D8C5; color: #292D20; border: 1px solid #E6E1D2; border-radius: 12px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; font: 600 16px/22px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #506B35; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Summary Surface
components.description: The one prominent paper surface for the current recorded nutrition summary.
components.html:
Asupan hari ini

Nilai yang tercatat beserta cakupan datanya.
components.css: .ds-summary { background: #FFFDF6; color: #292D20; border: 1px solid #E6E1D2; border-radius: 20px; padding: 16px; } .ds-summary h2 { font: 700 18px/24px system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-summary p { color: #55584B; font: 400 14px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0; }

components.name: Nutrient Data Row
components.description: Compact label, value, unit, and optional coverage note with a divider.
components.css: .ds-data-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-height: 46px; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #E6E1D2; color: #292D20; font: 400 14px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-data-row strong { font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Selected Tab
components.description: Selected destination remains clear through icon treatment and a readable label.
components.css: .ds-tab-selected { color: #506B35; font: 600 12px/16px system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
